Smalininkai Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Tauragė County, Lithuania

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' Smalininkai's Jewish community was not fully established until the 19th century, though a document from 1742 already references a Jewish-owned inn in the village. The town's synagogue, built in 1846, was later burned by the Nazis during WWII. This cemetery was destroyed during the Soviet era, its gravestones removed as raw material for construction — a process that reportedly continued even after 1990, following the fall of the USSR.
